name: unit
detail: Measured at the pinned head commit on 2026-08-28, not declared, after this fixture's own setup_commands (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` then `pnpm run build`) — vite's unit tests import the workspace's own vite package and cannot resolve it unbuilt. The suite reported 290 passed in 13.19s and the runner then did not exit; it was killed at the timeout. Recorded as passed because that is what it reported — the hang is a property of the runner in this repository, not a result.
